reviews.text: Sira loves this hair salon! And she always leaves looking gorgeous and super well cared for :)
We were delighted with both the hairdresser and the daycare. Thank you for taking such good care of them!

The girls are so loving with our dog, both when we leave him for a haircut and bath, and when we leave him for daycare! They play with him, walk him, and create a great environment, ideal for sociable and calm dogs.
Eros came out delighted and all white, smelling clean… everything was great and done with lots of love, Eros will be thrilled to come back! 🥰🥰 …
Wag and Roll did a wonderful job with our dog's haircut. He came home looking muy guapo. We would highly recommend them!

I took my Miniature Schnauzer for his first grooming last Friday and I couldn't be happier with the result. They did a fantastic job, paying attention to every detail and listening to all my requests.

What's more, they were excellent with my dog. They explained everything clearly and were very patient.
They made sure my dog ​​was calm and comfortable throughout the entire process. Without a doubt, this is a groomer I highly recommend and will definitely be back.

I can't say enough about how special, amazing, and professional they are.
I've finally found someone who takes care of my Perla's grooming.
They've made her look better than ever. I'm so grateful and highly recommend Wag and Roll; they are truly excellent. Their prices are reasonable, and they put all the love and professionalism into making my girl look her best. She even looks beautiful!
Everything was perfect: the service, the professionalism. Everything was incredible! I've finally found a new groomer for Nevado!! Thank you for making him look so good. We'll be back soon!!
